review: A beautiful, inspiring story about following your dreams.
Short and sweet, a good book for teenagers.
The characters feel more like symbols than real people.
Every page has a quote worth underlining.
Santiago's journey stayed with me long after I finished it.
Simple writing that is easy to read in one sitting.
Nice message but the plot is very thin.
Too simplistic and preachy, it reads like a long motivational poster.
I don't understand the hype, the ending was predictable.
The spiritual ideas are repeated again and again.
Good for a quick read, but not life changing for me.
The pocket edition is cheap and well printed.
The desert setting is described beautifully.
I reread it every year and find something new each time.
A fable with a simple but powerful message.
Paulo Coelho writes like a storyteller, warm and calm.
